item.title: Expand Hong Kong’s MPF investment choices, lure mainland pension funds: financial council
item.description: Hong Kong should consider allowing the Mandatory Provident Fund to invest in more asset classes, and lure more long-term patient mainland capital, such as pension funds, to invest globally through the city, the Financial Services Development Council (FSDC) said in a report on Tuesday. item.title: Chinese scientists propose turning abandoned coal mines into underground farms
item.description: Chinese scientists have proposed developing “underground agriculture” in abandoned coal mine tunnels as part of a push to create a green, circular economy for the country’s massive mining industry. item.title: Chinese grandma who struggles with Mandarin sings in 6 foreign languages
item.description: A 62-year-old woman from southern China, who cannot speak standard Mandarin or recognise the English alphabet, has gone viral on social media for singing over 100 songs in six different languages. Li Deru, known online as @Auntie Ru, boasts 800,000 followers and has garnered millions of likes across both domestic and international social media platforms.
